shortDescription: 10-week five-day full body strength and hypertrophy program.
descriptionHtml:
10-week five-day full body strength and hypertrophy program.

Structure: 10 weeks, 5 scheduled sessions per week, 50 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Lower Focused Full Body, Chest Focused Full Body, Back Focused Full Body, Lower Focused Full Body 2, and Deltoid Focused Full Body.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 10 weeks
  • Tags: full body and 5 days per week
